runs.question: Can you drop the executive-search fee from 22% to 15%?

output.question: Can you drop the executive-search fee from 22% to 15%?

context.text:
# Pricing Model

Executive headhunting:
- Standard fee: 22% of the hired role's gross annual salary.
- Billed in three installments: 30% when the search begins, 30% when the
  final shortlist is presented, 40% upon hire.
- Free replacement guarantee if the candidate leaves the role within 6
  months for causes attributable to the selection process.

context.section: 22% seems expensive compared to other firms.
context.text:
# Handling Common Prospect Objections

"22% seems expensive compared to other firms."
Suggested response: explain that the fee includes the 6-month replacement
guarantee and the reference verification process, which reduces the risk of
a bad hire. A discount below 22% must never be offered without Marcos
Ibáñez's approval.

# Modelo de Tarifas

Headhunting ejecutivo:
- Tarifa estándar: 22% del salario anual bruto del cargo contratado.
- Se factura en tres momentos: 30% al iniciar la búsqueda, 30% al presentar
  la terna final, 40% al momento de la contratación.
- Garantía de reemplazo gratuito si el candidato deja el cargo antes de 6
  meses por causas atribuibles al proceso de selección.
